query:
-- Analyser les formats de coconut_id
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN coconut_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN coconut_id LIKE 'LTS%' THEN 'LOTUS (LTS...)'
    WHEN coconut_id LIKE 'CNP%' THEN 'COCONUT (CNP...)'
    WHEN LENGTH(coconut_id) > 0 THEN 'Autre format'
    ELSE 'Vide'
  END as format,
  COUNT(*) as nb
FROM molecules
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY nb DESC;

-- Quelques exemples de coconut_id enrichis
SELECT id, name, coconut_id, coconut_organisms IS NOT NULL as has_organisms
FROM molecules 
WHERE coconut_id IS NOT NULL 
LIMIT 10;
